newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues short-term T-bill yields.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues short-term T-bill yields.

text.p: Bank of Lebanon announced on Monday yields for the April 24 issue of three-month and six-month Lebanese-denominated treasury bills.
The bank issued the following rate details (previous week in brackets):
The bank said it would issue the April 17 auction results on Tuesday instead of Monday. It will also announce the April 24 yields on 12-month and 24-month bills on the same day.
"The delay was a result of the four-day public holidays in Lebanon," a central bank official said.
Financial markets closed on Thursday and Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha holidays.
